description: Request of calling.limits.change (POST /internal/v1/operator/limits). The owner receives the request's tenant scope as its tenant; the body never names a tenant.

operation_id.description: HQ's command id; equal to the Idempotency-Key header.

reason_code.description: Kept in the bridge's operation record; not sent to the owning service.

expected_version.description: The resource version the command applies to (VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise); 0 means none yet where allowed.
